title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14655v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD) to track microscopic distribution shifts. We also curate CausalMSBench, a diagnostic dataset isolating language priors. Benchmarking reveals that popular Omni-LLMs exhibit critically low CMS, showing negligible distribution shifts even when key modalities are removed. To rectify this, we propose Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), a training-free inference-time framework that uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to estimate modal activation s

translated_title: 诊断与缓解全模态大语言模型中的感知-决策错位：基于模态子空间激活方法
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLMs）在诸如世界行动模型和自主智能体等应用中支持复杂的多模态推理。然而，其强大性能往往掩盖了深刻的感知-决策错位（PDM），即决策未能忠实于多模态感知。为诊断此问题，我们形式化了因果模态敏感性（CMS），并通过双视角框架实现：宏观行为层面的答案保留率（ARR）和微观分布偏移追踪的对数几率角度差异（LAD）。我们还构建了CausalMSBench诊断数据集，以隔离语言先验。基准测试显示，流行的Omni-LLMs表现出极低的CMS，即使在移除关键模态时也显示可忽略的分布偏移。为纠正此问题，我们提出模态子空间激活（MSA），一种无需训练的推理时框架，利用奇异值分解（SVD）估计模态激活。
tldr: 本文提出了一种诊断和缓解全模态大语言模型中感知-决策错位的新方法，通过因果模态敏感性和模态子空间激活框架，有效提升了模型对多模态信息的忠实度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel approach to diagnose and mitigate perception-decision misalignment in Omni-LLMs via causal modality sensitivity and modality subspace activation, enhancing faithfulness to multi-modal information.
